build_profiles.build: Pinned Linux 6.18.60; Umi CSOT Android header v2 metadata; built-in FG/SMB5/ADC5, sink-only Type-C/TCPM/BQ25970 PPS test profile and rescue RAM logger. Charge-positive standard battery CURRENT_NOW; composite BQ25970 register backend; optional raw SMB5 diagnostics without a synthetic DT device; firmware framebuffer via mainline simpledrm/KMS with fbdev console emulation. Hardware results are recorded separately in docs/platforms.md. Built-in SN100T Linux NFC/NCI transport with generic-netlink/AF_NFC interfaces; no private NQ character ABI, Android HAL or firmware downloader.

sources.verification: Exact commit checked against the repository remote; adapted DTS is BSD-3-Clause. Mixed-license panel/touch code was not imported. Read the pinned diagnostic config and report for early-console and boot-argument hypotheses; only standard options were selected for MiSeed, with no reference config or runtime claims imported. This bring-up pass also references the pinned Umi early-board support set to select SM8250 clocks, RPMh power domains, interconnect, SMMU, PMIC arbiter, and large fbcon font/rotation options; no upstream DTS/config file is copied into the project. Original compile assessment is archived at docs/archive/research/2026-11-08-upstream-power-port.md. Runtime adaptations and scoped local L3 are recorded at docs/archive/hardware/2026-11-08-umi-runtime-power.md; source reports and local hardware evidence remain separate. Native CSOT fixed command/timing data and board wiring selectively adapted on 2026-11-11; see kernel/display/NOTICE.md and the scoped L2/L3 assessment. Reference panel driver and private debug ABI not imported.
